name: Modal
usage_hint: Generic modal container with multiple trigger types (delay, scroll, exit-intent, click, event) and flexible content rendering via child islands or simple headline/body/image.
when_to_use: For email capture popups, size guides, video embeds, product quick-views, announcements, or any temporary overlay content. Use exit_intent trigger for lead recovery, delay trigger for timed promos, click trigger for "View Details" links.
when_not_to_use: For persistent navigation (use a sidebar instead). Don't use for critical checkout flows (modals can be accidentally closed). Avoid for long-form content (scrolling in modals is bad UX; use a dedicated page). Skip if mobile-first and content doesn't fit small screens.
anti_patterns: Multiple modals auto-triggering on one page (modal fatigue; coordinate triggers or pick one)
Not setting showOnce:true for promotional modals (spams user every page; always use showOnce for one-time offers)
exit_intent trigger without minimum delay (fires immediately on accidental mouse move; set triggerValue to 3000-5000ms)
Large child islands in sm or md size modals (content overflow; use lg/xl or fullscreen for complex child content)
backdrop:false without closable:false (users can't close modal, trapped; always allow escape)
Using position:fullscreen for simple messages (overkill; reserve fullscreen for video or multi-step flows)

examples.label: Exit-intent email capture modal (center, medium, once per session)
examples.source:
<lx-island name="Modal">
  <script type="application/json">{"trigger":"exit_intent","triggerValue":5000,"position":"center","size":"md","closable":true,"backdrop":true,"animation":"scale","showOnce":true,"storageKey":"newsletter_2024","headline":"Don't miss out!","body":"Join 10,000+ subscribers and get exclusive deals.","image":"/modal-hero.jpg","children":[{"island":"EmailCapture","props":{"placeholder":"Your email","buttonText":"Get 15% Off","discount":"15% OFF YOUR FIRST ORDER","endpoint":"/api/modal-signup"}}]}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Timed promo modal (5s delay, bottom position, compact)
examples.source:
<lx-island name="Modal">
  <script type="application/json">{"trigger":"delay","triggerValue":5000,"position":"bottom","size":"lg","closable":true,"backdrop":true,"animation":"slide-up","showOnce":true,"headline":"Flash Sale! 20% Off Ends Tonight","body":"Use code FLASH20 at checkout. Limited time only.","children":[{"island":"Button","props":{"text":"Shop Now","href":"/collections/sale"}}]}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Scroll-triggered size guide (50% scroll, right sidebar)
examples.source:
<lx-island name="Modal">
  <script type="application/json">{"trigger":"scroll","triggerValue":50,"position":"right","size":"md","closable":true,"backdrop":true,"animation":"slide-right","showOnce":false,"headline":"Need help with sizing?","body":"Check our detailed size chart to find your perfect fit.","children":[{"island":"SizeChart","props":{"chartType":"apparel"}}]}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Announcement modal with custom trigger button
examples.source:
<lx-island name="Modal">
  <script type="application/json">{"trigger":"click","position":"center","size":"md","closable":true,"backdrop":true,"animation":"scale","triggerLabel":"View Announcement","triggerVariant":"primary","headline":"New Feature Launch!","body":"We've just released our most requested feature. Check it out now.","image":"/announcement-banner.jpg"}</script>
</lx-island>
